text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 2: For three wind farms, adding UKV-CEDA's winds lowered the ENS mean's error at lead days 1 and 2 at both hyperparameter settings, against both shuffled controls, after the Bonferroni correction, and with any one month dropped. Day 3 rests on February 2026, and day 4 is inconclusive'
text.tspan: Figure 2: For three wind farms, adding UKV-CEDA's winds lowered the ENS
mean's error at lead days 1 and 2 at both hyperparameter settings,
against both shuffled controls, after the Bonferroni correction, and
with any one month dropped. Day 3 rests on February 2026, and day 4 is
inconclusive

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Difference in mean absolute error between two XGBoost models, first arm minus second, in points of capacity. Negative means the blend forecasts better. The blend lowers the error only if its interval and both shuffled- control intervals are below zero at both settings. Filled dot: primary setting. Lighter hollow mark: sensitivity setting. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed, at each setting. After the Bonferroni correction across the 8 P1 intervals per setting, P1 stays below zero at both settings at days 1 and 2. Largest gain P1's interval does not exclude where the reading is inconclusive, in points of capacity: day 4: primary 0.268, sensitivity 0.295. The three wind farms, up to 21 calendar months of out-of-fold forecasts. Every error is a fraction of the generator's own capacity, taken as its 99th percentile of metered output. UKV-CEDA's lead is 3 hours fresher than ENS's at every hour, which favours the blend. All rows are planned: written into the study plan before any result existed.'
text.tspan: Difference in mean absolute error between two XGBoost models, first arm minus second, in points of capacity.
Negative means the blend forecasts better. The blend lowers the error only if its interval and both shuffled-
control intervals are below zero at both settings. Filled dot: primary setting. Lighter hollow mark: sensitivity
setting. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole months and a fitting seed, at each setting.
After the Bonferroni correction across the 8 P1 intervals per setting, P1 stays below zero at both settings at days
1 and 2.
Largest gain P1's interval does not exclude where the reading is inconclusive, in points of capacity: day 4:
primary 0.268, sensitivity 0.295.
The three wind farms, up to 21 calendar months of out-of-fold forecasts. Every error is a fraction of the
generator's own capacity, taken as its 99th percentile of metered output. UKV-CEDA's lead is 3 hours fresher than
ENS's at every hour, which favours the blend.
All rows are planned: written into the study plan before any result existed.
